d: Long, flowing lavender-silver hair with blunt bangs is styled in a high ponytail tied with a vivid magenta ribbon. A single open light-blue eye is visible in a cheerful, winking expression on a youthful face. The slender build is dressed in a black, white, and magenta athletic outfit consisting of a sleeveless bodysuit under a short, oversized white and black jacket with magenta accents, paired with blue and black sneakers. Signature accessories include black sunglasses perched on the forehead, a black headset around the neck, a white ID badge, and a handheld microphone connected to a blue and black electronic device.
